query_hints.hint: To find records where a payroll period coincides with a performance review cycle: 1) Find peak payslip period using RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY gross_salary - net_salary DESC) 2) Find peak review cycle using RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY overall_score DESC) 3) Link them via: JOIN payroll_periods pp ON payslips.period_id = pp.period_id    JOIN performance_cycles pc ON performance_reviews.cycle_id = pc.cycle_id    WHERE pp.start_date >= pc.start_date AND pp.end_date <= pc.end_date
